metadata.title: अरबी अंडा कैसे बनता है |Tribal recipe of cooking tasty egg curry  | Bastar Foods
metadata.description: The egg curry is the easiest food to cook. But we learnt a new way of cooking egg curry in a tribal village of Bastar in Chhattisgarh. A tribal family here cooked egg curry with arabi for us. The whole process was very interesting and in the end we got to eat a very tasty andda curry with rice.
